functionalRequirement: User shall be able to set the price, quantity, upload pictures, and add details when listing an item.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support all item listing components including price input, quantity selection, picture upload, and detailed description for 100% of item types.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures comprehensive coverage of all specified item listing features

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Picture uploads must complete within 5 seconds for images up to 10MB in size, with support for concurrent uploads of up to 5 images simultaneously.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Addresses the need for efficient media upload during item listing process

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Implement validation rules that prevent invalid price entries (e.g., negative prices, non-numeric characters) and enforce minimum/maximum price ranges.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps users input correct information and prevents potential listing errors

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: Provide inline help tooltips and clear error messages for each item listing field to guide users through the listing process.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enhances user understanding and reduces potential confusion during item listing

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: Implement server-side validation to sanitize and validate all user-provided listing details to prevent injection attacks or malicious content.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects the platform from potential security vulnerabilities in user-generated content

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: Support multiple image formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP) and ensure compatibility with standard web and mobile image upload interfaces.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures flexible image upload across different devices and platforms

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modularity: Design the item listing feature with separate, loosely coupled components for price, quantity, image, and description inputs to facilitate future modifications.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows for easier updates and modifications to individual listing components

functionalRequirement: Doctors shall be able to log in to check patient information, answer patient queries, perform daily activities, set reminders, and communicate with their staff.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: Implement multi-factor authentication with mandatory two-factor authentication using time-based one-time passwords (TOTP).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures secure access to sensitive patient information

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: Encrypt all patient information using AES-256 encryption both at rest and in transit, with strict access controls based on user roles.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive medical information from unauthorized access

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: Maintain 99.99% system uptime with automatic failover and redundant server infrastructure to ensure continuous access to patient information.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Critical for healthcare professionals who need constant access to patient data

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Patient information retrieval must complete within 2 seconds for comprehensive patient records, supporting up to 100 concurrent user sessions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures quick access to critical patient information during medical consultations

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: Provide context-sensitive help, clear navigation, and intuitive interface design with role-based dashboards tailored to medical staff workflows.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Supports efficient navigation and task completion for medical professionals

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Analysability: Implement comprehensive logging of all system interactions with patient data, including user actions, access times, and modification details.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Supports audit trails and system troubleshooting for healthcare compliance

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Adaptability: Design the system to easily integrate with various Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and support future medical communication protocol standards.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures long-term compatibility and extensibility of the medical communication platform
